correctness.rationale: Mass entries are the elementary hat integrals; 6M is sign-conjugate to A=dI−B with nonnegative nearest-neighbor B of row sum d/2. The Neumann inverse is bounded, strictly positive entrywise by paths and exponentially decaying by distance. This gives a stable coefficient map on ℓ² and the canonical kernel extension to ℓ∞ inputs by absolute summability and truncation. Taking inverse row differences across the unit cell gives the reflected positive pair-source vector with alternating kernel signs. Its odd and even recurrences and the center-source equation uniquely force the decaying root and the stated β and u. The integral of the absolute affine interpolant is the sum of the two triangle areas, and geometric summation and reflection yield F; a sign input realizes the norm. Rescaling the other cell length multiplies its slope by 1/r, and the two translation classes exhaust slopes. /workspace/replay.py (splines, Python 3 + SymPy) checks the recurrence and exact special values, and independently evaluates the long branch at r=2 as 43/20−√105/28, strictly below F(2). Reciprocal symmetry gives q′(1)=0, and the branches tie at 1; their difference has positive right derivative there. F′(1)>0 but F(2)<F(1), proving nonmonotonicity. Scope is the full-line alternating positive mesh with Lebesgue measure and bounded-input kernel extension; neither finite boundaries nor arbitrary grading is inferred. Packaged finite tests were inspected, not executed or used as an infinite certificate.
